changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Add normalized FK cols, keep old VARCHAR for backward compat then migrate

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Populate FKs from old VARCHARs: EQUITY->1, INDEX->2, USD->1. No index/FK here (DuckDB needs commit first).
changeSet.sql: UPDATE dim.dim_instrument SET asset_class_id = CASE asset_class WHEN 'EQUITY' THEN 1 WHEN 'INDEX' THEN 2 WHEN 'CRYPTO' THEN 3 ELSE -1 END WHERE asset_class_id = -1
UPDATE dim.dim_instrument SET currency_id = CASE currency WHEN 'USD' THEN 1 WHEN 'INR' THEN 2 ELSE -1 END WHERE currency_id = 1 AND currency IS NOT NULL
UPDATE dim.dim_instrument SET sector_id = -1 WHERE sector_id = -1

rollback.sql: UPDATE dim.dim_instrument SET asset_class_id=-1, currency_id=1, sector_id=-1 WHERE instrument_id> -2

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: DuckDB ALTER FK not yet supported — keep logical FK (enforced via JOIN + 3NF views), indexes for performance
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_dim_inst_asset ON dim.dim_instrument(asset_class_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_dim_inst_curr ON dim.dim_instrument(currency_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_dim_inst_sector ON dim.dim_instrument(sector_id)

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Exchange currency VARCHAR -> FK currency_id (3NF) logical FK
changeSet.sql: UPDATE dim.dim_exchange SET currency_id = CASE currency WHEN 'USD' THEN 1 WHEN 'INR' THEN 2 ELSE -1 END WHERE currency_id = 1

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Gold denormalized views reconstruct 3NF via JOINs for analytics (no redundancy in base tables)
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_instrument_3nf AS SELECT i.instrument_id, i.symbol, i.name, ac.asset_class_code, c.currency_code, s.sector_name, ind.industry_name, e.exchange_code FROM dim.dim_instrument i JOIN dim.dim_asset_class ac ON ac.asset_class_id=i.asset_class_id JOIN dim.dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=i.currency_id JOIN dim.dim_sector s ON s.sector_id=i.sector_id JOIN dim.dim_industry ind ON ind.industry_id=s.industry_id JOIN dim.dim_exchange e ON e.exchange_id=i.exchange_id

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_ohlcv_3nf AS SELECT i.symbol, ac.asset_class_code, c.currency_code, s.sector_name, f.date, f.close, f.volume FROM dim.fact_market_ohlcv f JOIN dim.dim_instrument i USING(instrument_id) JOIN dim.dim_asset_class ac ON ac.asset_class_id=i.asset_class_id JOIN dim.dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=i.currency_id JOIN dim.dim_sector s ON s.sector_id=i.sector_id
